scope: Texts of the login, OTP, CONFIGURE_TOTP, UPDATE_PASSWORD, UPDATE_PROFILE, VERIFY_EMAIL, consent and forgot-password pages in each locale, with fallback through parent locales, the realm default and English, and the language links that re-show each page.
normalization: The base URL and realm names are replaced with placeholders; pages are reduced by tests/page_texts.py to title, heading, labels, buttons, login-actions links, list items, messages, field errors and the language choice (label, selected, login-actions step, kc_locale).
